description:
Kang Sera, who was born as the daughter of a top star couple and has been walking on a solid road as the most popular idol in Korea, suddenly announces her retirement and runs away to the countryside to her grandmother's cottage to enjoy life in a hermit. She runs away saying that she doesn't like singing or love anymore, but suddenly Sera meets an unexpected guy there... Does she say Sera can she sing again?

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Naver Webtoon](https://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list?titleId=802359), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=9081755)
